business_problem: Offshore Company needed to close a gap in Japan's AI video market by offering a localized service that could generate high-quality videos with Japanese-language support, culturally appropriate avatars, and a simpler production workflow than traditional video creation.
solution_summary: Offshore Company built its AvaMo service on top of Tencent Cloud to make AI video generation usable for Japanese customers instead of relying on generic global tools. Tencent Cloud's digital human creation technology acts as the generation backbone, while text-to-speech and voice-synthesis capabilities turn scripts into narrated, presenter-style videos without conventional filming and editing steps. Users submit video requirements through AvaMo, the AI stack renders avatar performance and spoken output, and the finished assets are returned through a self-service workflow tuned for local language and cultural expectations. By centering the implementation on Tencent's integrated media-AI services, Offshore Company created a faster, lower-cost path for businesses and individuals that need professional-looking localized video content at production speed.

solution_components.name: digital human creation technology
solution_components.role: Provides the avatar-generation engine behind AvaMo's automated video creation workflow.

solution_components.name: text-to-speech
solution_components.role: Converts user-provided scripts into spoken narration for generated videos.

solution_components.name: voice synthesis
solution_components.role: Produces natural-sounding voice output that matches the generated video presentation.

data_flow: Users submit scripts and video requirements into AvaMo, Tencent Cloud's digital human creation technology generates avatar-based scenes, text-to-speech and voice synthesis create the narration layer, and the completed localized videos are returned through Offshore Company's self-service platform for business use.
business_outcome: Offshore Company delivered a Japan-focused AI video service that reduces production effort and cost while giving users culturally relevant avatars, local-language support, and faster access to professional video content.
metrics: Production time and costs were reduced by up to 98%.
